title: Proposition Player #1 #2 Lot DC Vertigo 1999 2000 Bill Willingham John Bolton
condition_description: Both bright and clean with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Proposition Player #1 and #2 of 6 (December 1999 - January 2000), DC/Vertigo. Written by Bill Willingham (Fables), art by Paul Guinan and Ron Randall, painted covers by John Bolton. Suggested for mature readers. Direct sales, $2.50 cover price each.

- #1: back cover Resident Evil 3 Nemesis (PlayStation) ad
- #2: back cover Dino Crisis (Capcom, PlayStation) ad

Condition: both bright and clean with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
